main_text.p: sub fluftibus fervet, nusquam tamen apparet, ut & cætera omnia, ville, vici, fana, quæ in eo spa- cio fuerunt. In hos autem, qui superfunt, amnes, Rivi - agrum pererrantes.ut & in æstuaria vicina, rivi complures scaphis & lintrib. meabiles se effundunt: quorum alij orti ex se, aquis viam sibimet facientibus, alij humana industria excavati, hic illic regionem secant, & vicos plerosq; celebriores alluunt, duplici regionis bono. Nam & humiles atq; vdos agros aquis levant, & commeandi vectandiq; facultatem incolis commodissimam præstant. Sed qui Hunefum augent, aut in æstuaria aut Dullartum effunduntur, clauftris in exitu coercentur: cæteri libero lapfu Fivela fe mifcent. Duo etiam ad urbem ipfam Groningam longis brachijs se porrigunt, Honæus in occidente, Botteranus a borea. Populi regio- nem coletes.Populorum minorum hanc regionem habitantium nomina, fitus, ratio ita habent. Ad occidentem & meridiem Hunefi fluminis Langowvol- dij.Langowoldii Oftergois finitimi, complexi vicos finis insignes XIII: Fredevvoldij.FREDOWOLDII in eadem plaga Sylvestrib. ac Drentia propinqui, vicis X comprehensi, tenui in solo utriq; : Hummercii.HVMMERTZII in latere æstuarij Lavicani ad effluxum fluminis jam dicti, eluvionib. ad tres tantum vicos redacti, sed agri felicis, ubi rivus ex Drentia descendens, & Transhunefanam omnem regionem pererras canali novo ad castellum militare copressus in idem [?] æstuarium exit, & alluvio nunc reddit, & diluvia quondam & tempestatum vis abstulerunt: Medachii.MEDACHII ad eiusdem fluminis ripa introrsum magis timentes in vicos IX in solo perubere ac lato sparsi,

page.notes: Right margin notes are transcribed beside their lines. Capitalised words in the text (FREDOWOLDII, HVMMERTZII, MEDACHII, Langowoldii) are printed in small capitals. The page number reads "2ʒ" in the scan, taken as 23. The final words "sparsi," run to the bottom of the text block and may continue on the next page. Several readings are uncertain at the scan resolution and are not marked individually; the Latin words "idem", "Hunefum/Hunefi" and "copressus" should be checked against the original.
